race.title: Irish National Hunt Chase CLG Beginners Chase
race.verdict: A multiple winner over hurdles, GLEN KILN made a positive start over the larger obstacles here last month and gets the nod in what looks a cracking contest. Smart hurdlers Ballyfad and Storm Heart are feared most. GLEN KILN (IRE) BALLYFAD (IRE) STORM HEART (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Ballyfad (13/8), Hiddenvalley Lake (4/1), Glen Kiln (5/1), Storm Heart (6/1), Franciscan Rock (8/1), Kel Histoire (12/1), He Can't Dance (14/1), Kainsbourg (16/1), Largy Hill (33/1), Stede Bonnet (50/1), Accustomed (66/1), Sound As A Bell (66/1)
